statement: Relation (IV) of Nakamura, f(u,v^4) = v^(8 rho_2) f(u^2,v^2) u^(4 rho_2) (uv)^(-6 rho_2) in the profinite braid group on three strands, holds for every element (lambda, f) of the profinite Grothendieck-Teichmüller group, with rho_2 = rho_2(F).

Every element of GT-hat is a product F_* sigma with sigma a Galois element and F_* = (1, f_*) normalized (lambda = 1, rho_2 = 0), and f_* lies in the group Lambda of Hatcher, Lochak and Schneps; so GT-hat = Lambda_0 . G_Q.
The level-twelve character delta, comparing the frames at the two elliptic points of the modular curve, vanishes on every normalized element of GT-hat.
A homomorphism from GT-hat to F_2 that is trivial on Galois elements and equal to delta on the normalized elements is trivial.
